title: Eliana's Naiveté
subtitle: I'm Eliana! This site is for long, infrequent essays on my own naive questions.

posts.title: Another Typical Autoresearch Post
posts.description: I built a (mostly) autonomous system that took 3rd in GPUMode's eigh kernel competition. Two weeks, 1,293 experiments, 779 million output tokens, and ultimately an 8.56x speedup over torch. And three small fixes later, a real Shampoo training run 2.2x faster to quality.
